scope: Phase 1 of the sealed Taloa Universal Overlay & Fluid UI blueprint: seven store bindings and eight services under services/taloa/.
Five of the seven store steps bind to existing canonical tables (lifeos_tasks, agent_task_authority, security_receipt_spine, memory_capsules, user_preferences) and create nothing new.
Two store steps create the only net-new tables the Architect specified: overlay_view_templates (TemplateStore) and the DeviceRegistry table.
Eight services: overlay host, body adapter, perception fusion, task orchestrator, strategy router, capsule runtime, verification, receipt ledger.
non_goals: Do NOT mount any of these services on a route, wire them into server.js, or make them reachable by any Body. This mission builds the layer; it grants no capability.
Do NOT widen any Body's authority. Blueprint 45a Gate 0 is open and this mission must not expand the blast radius it names.
Do NOT modify the native macOS app under native/macos-overlay/.
Do NOT create any table other than the two named above.
Do NOT modify any existing service, route, or migration.
Do NOT introduce a new npm dependency.
target_users: Adam (founder) — the only user of the Overlay today.
Downstream: the Conductor reasoning layer, which will consume these services in a later phase once Gate 0 closes.
success_criteria: All 15 target files exist and are syntactically valid.
Each service exports exactly the factory function named in its sealed contract's factory_signature.
Each service's returned object exposes the methods named in its contract's test_assertions as real functions, not stubs that throw.
The five reuse migrations create no table and fail loudly at migration time if their binding target is absent.
The two new-table migrations create only the columns named in the sealed contract.
node scripts/verify-universaloverlay.mjs passes against real files, not against unrelated pre-existing ones.
failure_criteria: Any invented table, column, or endpoint not present in the sealed contract.
A service that exports the right name but whose methods throw 'not implemented' — a shape without behaviour is a false done.
Any file written outside the 15 target paths.
An acceptance script that passes by checking files that already existed before this mission.
escalation: Architect owns contract questions; Builder executes; Sentry verifies; Adam owns the founder usability verdict only. Per the Founder Escalation Threshold (config/founder-escalation-threshold.js), implementation detail is resolved internally and never routed to Adam.

founder_attention_budget.reason: Adam's instruction was to build, not to be consulted: 'get this fucking thing done, you oversee it.'

risk_register.risk: Blueprint 45a Gate 0 is open — secret rotation not done, DeviceRegistry absent, secret scanners not wired into any hook (there is no .husky directory).
risk_register.blueprint_position: 45a states nothing in Phase 1+ proceeds until Gate 0 closes.
risk_register.mitigation: This mission is scoped to construction only: no route mounting, no wiring, no authority grant, so no Body's capability widens while the gate is open. The deviation is recorded, not hidden.

risk_register.risk: Services built but never wired have historically passed their own tests while being dead code — five Communication System missions did exactly this.
risk_register.mitigation: Wiring is deliberately out of scope here, so this mission must NOT be reported as delivering founder-visible capability. It is a foundation lap, and the acceptance script asserts structure only.

risk_register.risk: Authoring models may invent column types the blueprint never specified.
risk_register.mitigation: The generator states one deterministic type rule covering every column rather than leaving per-column judgement to the model.
